# CHAPTER XVIIIOf Religion by Deliverance and Renunciation

Arjuna. Fain would I better know, Thou Glorious One!The very truth- Heart's Lord!- of Sannyas,Abstention; and Renunciation, Lord!Tyaga; and what separates these twain!Krishna. The poets rightly teach that SannyasIs the foregoing of all acts which springOut of desire; and their wisest sayTyaga is renouncing fruit of acts.
